correctness.rationale: The first-coordinate full-branch itinerary is independent with probabilities 1/4,1/4,1/2; vertical binary digits are prepended fairly or deleted, giving a symmetric simple random walk S with minimum m_n. Tracking surviving initial digits gives C_n=(1/12)E[2^(2m_n-S_n)]. Decomposing paths by first downcrossing and nonnegative terminal segment gives G(z)=r(z)/(6z(1-r(z)/2)^2), r(z)=(1-sqrt(1-z^2))/z. The only unit-circle branch singularities are z=+1,-1 with respective singular coefficients -2sqrt(2), -2sqrt(2)/81, yielding C_n=sqrt(2/pi)(1+(-1)^n/81)n^(-3/2)+O(n^(-5/2)). Independent exact rational walk recursion and formal-power-series coefficients agree for n=0..23.
